content: Peen Ko Gaynam Nasha Zaskimino
Yesa shaarinte banqibee uuribe hamora ko nivaa? Yesa waante dahayse uximayna igina yesa anngarmanatayu?
Yeda anngardhe, yena maatehe; ogonante eenam yeda deese. Yeda woogimbhe, haapana damattene; ogonante uuri yeda kanse. Yin ko dahaakaar Barjoam yenin miskimonna yena maatehe.
Yenin miskayno yesa waanam wozisendar hacchota siya bhocchika yenin miskenna kosa malsinam haapattene.
Yedi Barjoam garaynato! Peen ko gaynam nashintano Barjoam jibbinta konin dohonam dhesattenu? Ta peen ko gaynam nashota zagea wul Barjoam jibbea ki maatade.
Pir Mathaap Gazante “Barjo wosa woylaminte konin doadettsi wona kinin imoono Manpasino Barjona bish wonin doadettsi kattsi koda anngardhe” hamayse thaapadhoono sun yena ko maato?
Barjo yisa sunin imintonam saskayse wona kida ime. Ogona Mathaapinte “Barjo poorimbhaynaam jibba ki jibbe; yisa metenam toskaynana sunin imintonam ima ki ime” kinin hamoono ogonane.
Ogonante Barjona ee hamee. Seethaanam jibbee; kidiar yekalanka pegadha ki pegadhe.
Barjokal theedee, kidiar yekal theeda ki theede. Yedi seeson eenato, yesa aaninam gazinsee; yedi qaabo lamaaka dahaanato, yesa woylaminam gazinsee.
Gaalee, burqadhee, eepee; yesa hancino siidar, yesa wozano gaaledar ko ookime.
Imba Barjo birante yesa metenam toskee; kidi yeam dheg dheg kida haye.
Eedidar Pirda Zaskimino

Imbanaanato, kinka kidar wuupo giyeebhode. Imbanaasasa wuupo giyea way imbanaasadar pirdea yigginsa wuupo kida giye, yiggindarar kida pirde. Yiggindar ha pirdidianna, ya pirdeane; yigginam tooleatehe.
Yigginam imeabee pirdeabe kalaane; kidi dhacchanabee kaysanabe dameane. Ta eedidar pirdea ya hayne?
Erimen Goynka Imbhoono Wacimeno
Yedi “Kina way saka ogo kataman yivayse leve kalaa ogote woda dee; gabante naggadaate birre woda thoose” hamaynato, mete yesaam gishee!
Saka maatenam dhesattene. Yesa sadano hardettsine? Tokaa wodana haapadhayse kayen liilodettsine.
Ogosa oolonte “Imba Barjo giydi ki hanna, sadaka dahaa wo hanna, koam way ogoam woda haye” hama yeam koda zaske.
Keeda yesa pormakkonka yeda erime; ogodettsino erimeno wul siyane.
Ogonante payyan waadimanam dhesayse waadadhimaana seeso koda maate.
